sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Menu to run the app on Mac or Linux
sections.what: Activates the virtual environment, shows a five-option menu, and runs the chosen command. Options cover a seven-day fetch, a one-day fetch, the dashboard alone, the seven-day fetch followed by the dashboard, and exit.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives the owner a simple menu instead of remembering commands.
sections.watch_out: The script stops right away if the venv folder is missing, so setup must be run first.

summary: A menu script for Mac and Linux that starts the app in one of five ways: fetch news for a week, fetch for one day, open the dashboard, fetch then open the dashboard, or exit.
purpose: Lets the owner run the app by choosing a number instead of typing commands.
why: Likely reason: saves the owner from remembering command options.
how: Activates the virtual environment, shows the menu, reads the choice, and runs the matching main.py command. Any other choice prints an error and exits.
inputs: The owner's menu choice typed at the prompt.
outputs: Terminal messages, plus whatever the chosen command produces, such as log lines or the dashboard.
risks: Stops immediately if the venv folder is missing, because it expects setup to have run. Option 4 runs the dashboard after the fetch, which keeps the terminal busy until Ctrl+C. Mac and Linux only.
debug: If the script stops at the start, check that a venv folder exists in the project folder. If a menu option fails, run its main.py command by hand to see the full error.
